messages:
Alice: quick sanity check — proposal to allow midstream preemption of streaming sessions for high-priority bursts. idea is: reclaim preemptible slots but expose a short 'grace window' where the edge tries to either finish the current token chunk or emit a resumable checkpoint. low-latency svc can steal capacity, but we avoid throwing away client progress.
Ben: do you mean forcibly close the connection and return a resume token, or keep the stream open and migrate it?
Alice: prefer resume token + soft-close. we can attempt in-place migration when upstream supports session splice, but default fallback is soft-close w/ resume token. that keeps gateway simpler.
Caroline: sketch of policy I had in mind:
```json
{
  "preemptible": true,
  "grace_window_ms": 250,
  "checkpoint_on_preempt": "kv-snapshot",
  "fallback": "resume-token",
  "priority_threshold": "burst-high",
  "max_retries": 1
}
```
Caroline: grace_window is intentionally small (100-500ms) to avoid head-of-line stalls. we try to flush pending tokens and snapshot KV cache. if snapshot fails, emit resume-token with best-effort cursor.
Dmitri: how does this interact with hedging? if we spawn hedged request, both might race to take the snapshot and we could have duplicate tokens.
Alice: good q. plan: only the first actor to successfully snapshot claims the resume token. others abort snapshot. gateway will keep an idempotency tag in the token to dedupe on resume.
Ben: what about ordering semantics for partial responses? apps expect monotonic stream. if we resume mid-utterance, we must guarantee no duplicated text or gaps.
Erin: either we guarantee prefix-only resumes (client replays from checkpoint) or we offer server-side replay where gateway replays buffered tokens to the resumed connection. replay is heavier but simpler for clients.
Caroline: replay requires buffering per-session; we can make it optional: small replay buffer size (e.g., last 2KB) configurable per-tenant. default is prefix-only resume + client-side dedupe.
Alice: operational notes: metric we need: preempt_success_rate, resume_replay_failures, avg_grace_time, snapshot_latency. include an alert when resume_replay_failures > 0.5% over 5m.
Dmitri: also need TTL for resume tokens and a revocation mechanism if session is no longer valid (auth change).
Ben: edge-case: what if preempting for a burst that itself is headed to same tenant? circular preemption. we should prevent tenant-level preemption loops with a backoff and score.
Caroline: agree — add tenant_preempt_cooldown: 30s and global_preempt_budget per-node.
Erin: can we simulate in the staging harness? i can add a chaos test that forces preempts at 200QPS and asserts no >1% lost tokens.
Alice: please do. next steps: Caroline to draft a tiny RFC doc with sequence diagrams + policy JSON variants. Dmitri will spec token format (idempotency tag + cursor + HMAC). Erin will add chaos test. I'll spike a prototype in the edge proxy branch. :thumbsup:
